newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danisco acquires Swiss packaging company.
newsitem.headline: Danisco acquires Swiss packaging company.

text.p: Danish packaging, drinks, food and sugar producer Danisco A/S said on Wednesday its Danisco Flexible unit took over Switzerland's Schuepbach AG packaging company with effect from January 1, 1997.
It said it acquired Shuepbach AG's shares for 14.75 million Swiss francs, the equivalent of 66 million Danish crowns or some 280 million crowns on a debt free basis.

Shuepbach, based near Berne, produces multi-layer and other forms of packaging for snacks, instant soups, chocolate and pharmaceuticals mainly for the Swiss and German markets with 240 employees and annual turnover of 400 million crowns, it said.
Danisco added that the deal was subject to the formal approval of the Swiss authorities.
